title: Transfer: Match Marketplace Listings to a Restricted Catalog
goal: Compare seller listing titles against a restricted brand catalog with noisy abbreviations, bundle text, and formatting variation, then save probable restricted matches and their canonical targets to /root/restricted_listing_matches.json.
skillBenefitRationale: The main problem is resolving messy product-title variants to canonical restricted catalog entries; fuzzy matching is the only key shipped skill that makes the moderation decision possible.
